Repeat.

Repeat.

112-1367-6496.manaNeeded: {11}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-1367-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-1367-6496.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Nexus of Fate and exiling the original Nexus of Fate with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Nexus of Fate copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Nexus of Fate and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Nexus of Fate's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Nexus of Fate and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Nexus of Fate's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-1367-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Nexus of Fate is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Nexus of Fate is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.

2011-2060-4120-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.

Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-2060-4120-6758.notes: As long as Crystalline Crawler has enough +1/+1 counters on it, you do not need to target it in step 1, allowing you to put +1/+1 counters on other creatures you control if desired.

4222-4832-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.
